Strategy: When the number of feasible bins is odd the rule is Best Fit, but when it is even the rule takes the emptiest bin, so the parity of the bin count flips the preferred bin. It differs from Best Fit only on even counts. It may help if even-count states correlate with surplus capacity, or fail because parity is arbitrary and may flip choices for no packing reason.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    n = len(bins)
    return [(-(r - item) if n % 2 == 1 else r) for r in bins]
```
